title: Bug: T2 Upgrade path logic is wrong
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Previously we tried reusing as much as possible of the generic upgrade path test, however there exists a logic error where the test downgrades and upgrades each LC seperately rather than as a chassis in our impementation. We need to fix this

e.g.
What we want:
- All DUTs downgraded to version A
- Supervisor upgrades to version B
- LCs upgrade to version B
- Health checks
What we have:
- Supervisor downgrades to version A
- Supervisor upgrades to version B (LCs haven't been touched)
- LCs (in parallel) downgrade to version A and upgrade to version B
- Health checks

### Steps to Reproduce

Logic error, run upgrade_path/test_upgrade_path.py::test_upgrade_path_T2

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

As above:

What we want:
- All DUTs downgraded to version A
- Supervisor upgrades to version B
- LCs upgrade to version B
- Health checks
What we have:
- Supervisor downgrades to version A
- Supervisor upgrades to version B (LCs haven't been touched)
- LCs (in parallel) downgrade to version A and upgrade to version B
- Health checks
